definitions.explanation: The number two when counting things using native Japanese numbers.

examples.japanese: {二|ふた}つ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{分|わ}ける→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧。
⟦りんご→りんご：02269_ringo⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{二|ふた}つ⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
⟦{問題|もんだい}→問題：00797_mondai⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{二|ふた}つ⟦あります→ある：00006_aru⟧。
{二|ふた}つ⟦とも→とも：noentry⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧⟦です→です：09485_desu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧、⟦こちら→こちら：00960_kochira⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦いい→いい：00118_ii⟧。
examples.english: I like both, but this one is better.

examples.japanese: {二|ふた}つ⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{方法|ほうほう}→方法：03621_houhou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦ので→ので：09501_node⟧、⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧⟦な→な：09497_na⟧⟦{方|ほう}→方：01139_hou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{選|えら}んで→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧。
examples.english: There are two methods, so please choose the one you prefer.

notes:
{二|ふた}つ is the native Japanese number "two" used for counting general objects.

NATIVE COUNTING SYSTEM (1-10):
- ⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧, {二|ふた}つ, ⟦{三|みっ}つ→三つ：02970_mittsu⟧, ⟦{四|よっ}つ→四つ：03039_yottsu⟧, ⟦{五|いつ}つ→五つ：02892_itsutsu⟧
- ⟦{六|むっ}つ→六つ：02974_muttsu⟧, ⟦{七|なな}つ→七つ：02926_nanatsu⟧, ⟦{八|やっ}つ→八つ：02979_yattsu⟧, ⟦{九|ここの}つ→九つ：02902_kokonotsu⟧, ⟦{十|とお}→十：28376_too⟧

USAGE:
Native numbers (⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧, {二|ふた}つ, etc.) are used when:
- No specific counter applies
- Counting abstract things or general items
- Casual, everyday counting
Beyond 10, native numbers are rarely used. Use Sino-Japanese numbers (⟦{十一|じゅういち}→十一：00949_juuichi⟧, etc.) instead.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {二|ふた}つ⟦ください→ください：02899_kudasai⟧: Two, please
- {二|ふた}つ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{分|わ}ける→分ける：02333_wakeru⟧: to divide in two
- {二|ふた}つ⟦とも→とも：noentry⟧: both (of them)
- {二|ふた}つ⟦{目|め}→目：noentry⟧: the second one
